description: VELMA models watershed hydrology and the movement of nutrients and contaminants. It compares natural and engineered green-infrastructure scenarios and addresses how performance can change with soil conditions, loading and climate. The resource is documented by United States Environmental Protection Agency. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. The provider identifies version 2.1 as available and version 2.2 as following external review; do not label 2.2 as released. The documented functions can inform infrastructure simulation inputs, intervention comparisons or operational scenarios. Numerical performance was not independently checked. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied.
